items.why: Iranian attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz pushed Brent above $101, lifting yields and the dollar, and over $540M in leveraged crypto longs were liquidated. Traders are also de-risking ahead of today's Fed minutes.

Giving back part of its big Muse-driven rally, which lifted shares over 20 percent in September. Wells Fargo set a $1,000 target Tuesday, but the stock is cooling with the broader tape as yields spike.
Carrying over Tuesday's strength, when it led mega-cap tech despite insider selling noise. AWS added Zhipu's GLM-5.3 model to Bedrock this week, reinforcing cloud AI momentum.
Small caps are getting hit hardest as the 10-year yield climbs above 5.3 percent. Rate-sensitive small caps carry more floating-rate debt, and the Russell 2000 is nearing correction territory.

market_note: Dow futures down 0.65 percent, S and P futures down 0.28 percent; Fed meeting minutes due later today.
summary: Stocks are slipping midday as Treasury yields hit fresh 24-year highs and Iranian tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz sent oil soaring, pressuring risk assets across the board.
